questions.q: What is required to make a Lightning page built in App Builder available on the Salesforce mobile app?
options: A completely separate mobile-only build
Rewriting the page in Visualforce
A separate Apex class for mobile rendering
Nothing extra — Lightning pages render on both desktop and mobile from a single build
questions.explain: Lightning pages render on both surfaces from one build; there's no separate mobile app to construct.

questions.q: How many items from the mobile navigation menu also appear in the bottom tab bar?
options: The first four
All of them
Only one
None — they are entirely separate lists
questions.explain: The first four items in the mobile nav menu also populate the always-visible bottom tab bar, in that same order.

questions.q: When a custom app appears on the Salesforce mobile app, what changes about it compared to desktop?
options: It becomes a completely different app with a different name
Its underlying objects change
Its identity (name, icon, underlying tabs) stays the same; only the navigation arrangement changes for the smaller screen
Security and sharing rules are dropped on mobile
questions.explain: It's the same app — same name, icon, and tabs — just arranged differently for mobile; nothing about its identity changes.

questions.q: Where does an admin set the mobile navigation order independently of the desktop nav bar order?
options: Object Manager
The app's Activation dialog, under the Mobile Navigation tab
The compact layout editor
The Translation Workbench
questions.explain: The Activation dialog's Mobile Navigation tab controls mobile menu order specifically, separate from the desktop Lightning Experience tab.

questions.q: Why won't reordering the desktop navigation alone guarantee a tab's position on mobile?
options: Mobile navigation order is set independently via its own Mobile Navigation tab, not inherited automatically from desktop
Desktop and mobile share no configuration at all
Mobile apps cannot display custom tabs
Mobile navigation is fixed and can never be changed
questions.explain: Mobile order is an explicit, separate admin choice — it doesn't automatically mirror whatever order was set for desktop.
